title: fix(lint): security-owd-unset's fix line on a writable external object names security-external-owner-unmapped's ways out, not 'private'
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiVy7F2atKWpo5rp3YPrqddh)_

Fixes #27472
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 可写外部对象（`external.writable: true`）没写 `sharingModel` 时，`security-owd-unset` 的修复提示不再推荐 `private`，改为给出 `security-external-owner-unmapped` 的两条出路；`os explain security-owd-unset` 补了一段说明这个例外。
- **为什么改：** 旧提示对所有自定义对象一律推荐 `private`，而可写外部对象照做后，另一条警告又说成员每次编辑都会被拒，两条提示互相打架。
- **风险与回滚：** 只改提示文字，报错级别和报错正文不变，元数据契约不变；普通对象的提示一字未动。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/lint/src/validate-security-posture.ts`（`SECURITY_OWD_UNSET` 分支的 hint）、`packages/lint/src/validate-external-owner-sharing.ts`（导出复用的两条出路措辞与判定）、`packages/lint/src/validate-external-owner-sharing.test.ts`（末尾新 describe）。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint exec vitest run src/validate-external-owner-sharing.test.ts`，预期全绿，其中 `security-owd-unset's fix line on a writable external object` 五条通过。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`security-owd-unset` fix line (`validate-security-posture.ts`).** For a custom object with no `sharingModel` that `security-external-owner-unmapped` would judge, the hint now names that rule's two ways out instead of recommending `'private'`. Those objects are a writable binding (`external.writable: true`), not on a datasource this stack declares with `external.allowWrites: false`, and declaring no ownership column a remote row serves (`owner_id`, or `created_by` on an object without one). The new hint reads, for `spike_owned`:
  `declare sharingModel: 'public_read_write' and decide who may edit in a beforeUpdate hook, or declare owner_id in fields and have the driver return the remote owner under that name (a built-in SQL driver does it through external.columnMap; a plugin driver must return it itself) and declare sharingModel: 'private' or 'public_read'; 'controlled_by_parent' for master-detail children`
  Severity (`error`), the verdict line and `path` are unchanged. Every other object keeps today's hint byte for byte.
- **One phrasing, not three (`validate-external-owner-sharing.ts`).** `PUBLIC_READ_WRITE_WAY_OUT` and the declaration clause (`declareOwnershipColumnWayOut(column)`) are now exported from the rule that owns them. The judgement "does this object have an ownership gap" moves into `externalOwnershipGap(obj, readOnlyDatasources)`, and the datasource set into `readOnlyExternalDatasources(stack)`. Both rules call the same predicate, so the hint swaps on exactly the objects the warning fires on. These are module exports, not barrel exports: the package's public surface is unchanged. The external rule's own findings are byte-identical, and its existing whole-hint pins stay green.
- **`os explain security-owd-unset` (`rule-explanations.ts`).** A new paragraph explains the writable-external exception to the `'private'` recommendation, names the two ways out and points at `os explain security-external-owner-unmapped`.
- Changeset: `@objectstack/lint` patch.

## Tests

- `validate-external-owner-sharing.test.ts` adds the describe block `security-owd-unset's fix line on a writable external object`:
  - `spike_owned` (the spike stack, verbatim) gets the external hint (both shared clauses, no `recommended`), with severity, path and message unchanged;
  - a managed custom object (`leave_request`) keeps the old hint, pinned whole;
  - an `ownership: 'none'` external object is told to declare `created_by`;
  - a read-only binding, a declared `owner_id` and an `allowWrites: false` datasource keep the old hint;
  - either way out, once taken (`public_read_write`, or `private` plus a declared `owner_id`), clears both rules.
- `validate-security-posture.test.ts`: the explanation pin also asserts the external paragraph. The receiver meta-test (#5017) excuses `ownershipGap`, which is the helper's own return value and not metadata.
- Ablation: with the fix committed, `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced `const ownershipGap = externalOwnershipGap(obj, readOnlyDatasources);` with `undefined` (anchor 1 → 0, blob `ce9dd0f8e857` → `f178c04309b6`). Two of the new pins went red (`spike_owned …`, `names created_by …`), 24 stayed green. The tool restored the file (blob == HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). The test imports `src/` by relative path, so no `dist/` rebuild was involved.

## Acceptance notes

- **The hint swaps only where the warning fires, which is narrower than the card's literal "`external.writable: true`".** An external object that already declares `owner_id` (or `created_by` on an object without `owner_id`), or that sits on an `allowWrites: false` datasource, keeps the `'private'` recommendation. There `security-external-owner-unmapped` is silent and `'private'` is not the refused shape: the owner edits, and since #27476 reads are scoped by the owner it proves. This follows the card's first clause ("names the ways out `security-external-owner-unmapped` names"). Where that rule names none, there is nothing to name.
- The guide (`content/docs/data-modeling/virtual-objects.mdx`, the "Choose the sharing model on purpose" callout) still reads true and is not edited.
- `packages/cli/test/explain-rule-id.test.ts` pins the managed-object hint, which is unchanged. It is declared to CI: the CLI's dependency closure is not built in this container (the file fails to load on `@objectstack/types` resolution, before any assertion runs).

## Verification

The tests ran on the code tree of `c4b4bd65`. The head `4e9b79ca` adds only the changeset, so its code is the same. The gate commands ran at `4e9b79ca`.

- `pnpm --filter '@objectstack/lint^...' build` under `os-verify-lock.sh`: VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint typecheck && pnpm --filter @objectstack/lint test` under the lock: VERDICT command-exit 0; `Test Files 177 passed (177)`, `Tests 7604 passed | 5 skipped (7609)`. The typecheck ran `tsc --noEmit` and `check:test-typecheck`.
- Targeted: `vitest run src/validate-external-owner-sharing.test.ts src/validate-security-posture.test.ts src/rule-explanations.test.ts src/validate-security-posture.runtime-surface.test.ts`: `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 228 passed (228)`.
- Ablation (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, see Tests): VERDICT command-exit 1, `Tests 2 failed | 24 passed (26)`, restored `blob == HEAD (ce9dd0f8e857)`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 58 commands derived; all 58 were run with their exit codes recorded. `--ran`: "58 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 55 run, 3 NOT-MEASURED (3 DERIVED from a recorded exit 3)". 55 exited 0, including `check:docs-transcript-drift` ("4 declared transcript value(s) across 471 page(s) … equal what the registry derives today"), `check:doc-authoring`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs` and `check:type-check-debt`.

  - `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`: a shallow clone cannot reach its pinned positive-control commit;
  - `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `pnpm check:lean-entry-closure`: both read built `dist/` of packages outside this closure.
- NOT MEASURED, declared to CI: `packages/cli/test/explain-rule-id.test.ts`. The CLI closure is not built here, so the file fails to load (`@objectstack/types` entry unresolved) before any assertion runs. It pins the managed-object hint, which this diff leaves unchanged.
